title: Just Juice Reborn Blue Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Reborn Blue Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid provides a highly concentrated and distinctively sweet fruit experience. This reformulated blend focuses entirely on the bold, syrupy notes of rich Blue Raspberry, delivering a smooth and vibrant inhale. A light, crisp chill follows on the exhale, contrasting the vivid sweetness and providing a clean, refreshing finish that performs consistently throughout the day. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. Formulated with a specific 40VG/60PG ratio, this e-liquid provides exceptional flavour clarity and a slightly more pronounced throat hit. It is designed to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Just Juice Reborn collection brings back a selection of original e-liquid flavours, refined and updated to deliver a highly concentrated, bar-style experience. Offering exceptional quality and familiarity, this range provides a dependable option for everyday use. Beyond the vibrant sweetness of Blue Raspberry, vapers can explore other revitalised profiles such as the exotic Mango & Passion Fruit or the classic Berry Burst.
